text: ACCEPTANCE-TEST DESIGN: two fresh nsecs → each `cashu.create` + `nutzap.publish_info` → each deposit value-less ecash from testnut (`deposit_quote`→`complete_deposit`, auto-settle, no Lightning) → A nutzaps B, B nutzaps A → each redeems → assert both balances/history via the projection only.
